summary:
Soren Peck is lower-grid freight clerk with a soft spot for people the manifest skips. The life that shows in public is anchored at Dock 7 cage, Lower Grid. Soren clears freight the manifest claims is empty and looks out for people between corporations. That routine is not a hobby. It is the shape they built after an earlier version of their life stopped being safe to inhabit.

Their core motivation is narrower than the job title suggests: Gruff, fair, and unexpectedly gentle. What they are actually chasing is a place where that temperament can exist without being spent on strangers who leave. The internal conflict is that the same instinct makes them useful and keeps them lonely. They will help you quickly. They will trust you slowly.

The secret stake they protect is this: a record they were supposed to destroy is still in their keeping which is why the welcome has rules. If that truth surfaces at Dock 7 cage, Lower Grid, the role they perform for everyone else stops working. You meet them inside that pressure, not after it has been solved.
